findings.description: Critical: packages/gen-eval/tests/test_integration_scenarios.py:45 and packages/gen-eval/tests/test_integration_orchestrator.py:34 still resolve scenario roots to the missing repo-root path evaluation/gen_eval/scenarios. I ran `cd packages/gen-eval && uv run pytest tests/test_integration_scenarios.py tests/test_integration_orchestrator.py -q --tb=line` and observed 7 failures; logs print `Scenario directory not found: .../evaluation/gen_eval/scenarios/<category>` and `report.total_scenarios == 0`. Module-level `pytestmark = pytest.mark.integration` keeps CI green (`uv run pytest -m "not e2e and not integration"`), but the package Makefile `test` target is `uv run pytest -q -m "not slow"`, which *includes* these tests. `uv run pytest -q -m "not slow and integration" --tb=no` reported `7 failed, 1 passed`. A default package test target that is permanently red is a broken gate.
findings.resolution: Point the integration tests at fixtures that exist (or skip with a clear message when the path is absent), and align `make test` with CI so the default local suite cannot collect permanently failing integration cases.

findings.description: Nit: openspec/changes/derive-descriptors-from-contracts/specs/gen-eval-framework/spec.md:215-227 still requires reclamation to `SHALL increment the descriptor contract version`, and packages/gen-eval/src/gen_eval/descriptor.py:413 still says reclamation is why the spec requires a contract-version increment. Empirically: `uv run python -c "from gen_eval.contracts import CONTRACT_VERSION; print(CONTRACT_VERSION)"` prints `2`; VERSION and all three published schemas still carry `x-gen-eval-contract-version: 2`; `git diff c6d8eefb..HEAD -- packages/gen-eval/src/gen_eval/contracts/__init__.py` is empty. The schema diff is additive only (OperationCoverage / declared_interface_count fields). tasks.md:532-539 correctly forbids a bump. The delta requirement and ToolDescriptor docstring still demand a bump the implementation correctly refused.
findings.resolution: Amend the delta reclamation requirement/scenario and the ToolDescriptor docstring to require a downstream notice and package-level export correction without an extra JSON Schema CONTRACT_VERSION bump for Python export reclamation.

findings.description: Optional: packages/gen-eval/src/gen_eval/descriptor.py:377 deprecation only checks `if not data.get("contract")` (truthiness of the key). I wrote a ToolDescriptor YAML with `contract: missing-contract.yaml` (file does not exist), `executable: x`, and a hand-authored flag, then called `load_descriptor`. Observed: type ToolDescriptor, 0 DeprecationWarnings, `contract` path resolves to a non-existent file (`exists False`), interfaces still `['cli:--a']`. Any non-empty contract string silences the hand-authored deprecation while the surface remains hand-typed and undrift-checked — the exact silent path D6’s warning exists to surface.
findings.resolution: Warn (or fail closed) when `contract` is set but does not resolve to a readable file, or when the loaded surface was not produced by derivation from that contract.

findings.description: Nit: packages/gen-eval/scripts/check_coverage_completeness.py:10-11 still says dogfood exercises 5 of 17 flags. After `make dogfood` the real report at evaluation/.reports/gen-eval-report.json shows `coverage_pct` 58.8% with 10 exercised units and 7 exclusions (`coverage complete: 10 of 17 units exercised (58.8%), 7 excluded with reasons`). The Makefile comment correctly states 10/17. Stale gate documentation understates current dogfood strength.
findings.resolution: Update the script docstring counts to match the current dogfood suite (10 exercised / 7 excluded), or drop hard-coded counts and point at the report.

findings.description: Nit: packages/gen-eval/evaluation/README.md Layout (lines 30-41) and scenario table omit Phase 5 artifacts that now exist and gate dogfood: evaluation/scenarios/flag-surface.yaml and evaluation/coverage-exclusions.yaml. I listed evaluation/scenarios/ and found four YAML files including flag-surface.yaml; make dogfood runs check_coverage_completeness.py against coverage-exclusions.yaml. A new reader of evaluation/README.md cannot discover the completeness gate or flag-surface scenarios from the documented layout.
findings.resolution: Add flag-surface.yaml and coverage-exclusions.yaml to the layout and document the D11 completeness step that make dogfood runs after gen-eval.

findings.description: Nit: packages/gen-eval/scripts/check_coverage_completeness.py main() catches FileNotFoundError and ValueError from load_exclusions, but not yaml.parser.ParserError. I wrote an exclusions file containing `exclusions: [` and ran `uv run python scripts/check_coverage_completeness.py --report evaluation/.reports/gen-eval-report.json --exclusions <bad>`. Exit code was 1 (fail-closed) but stderr was a raw YAML traceback rather than the script’s `_fail(...)` message used for every other guard. Same pattern as the documented missing-descriptor traceback.
findings.resolution: Catch YAML parse errors in main() and return `_fail(str(exc))` so the gate fails with an operator-readable reason.

findings.description: FYI: packages/gen-eval/src/gen_eval/openapi.py:resolve_path_item returns only the $ref target and drops sibling keys on the referencing path item. I ran ServiceDescriptor.from_contract on an OAS 3.1 document where `/items/{id}` had both `$ref: #/components/pathItems/Items` and sibling path `parameters: [{name: id, ...}]`. Result: one operation, `params []` — the sibling `id` parameter was lost. Path-level parameters declared *inside* the resolved path item do merge (verified: tenant+q on list_items). OAS 3.1 leaves same-field conflicts with $ref undefined; treat as residual gap if consumers rely on ref+sibling parameter authoring.
findings.resolution: If supporting OAS 3.1 ref+sibling path items is in scope, merge non-$ref siblings from the referencing path item into the resolved item (at least parameters) before extraction; otherwise document that only parameters on the resolved path item are considered.

findings.description: Round-7 #1 FIXED (archetype-aware loading). `InterfaceDescriptor.from_yaml(evaluation/descriptor.yaml)` still yields 0 interfaces, but `load_descriptor` (used by __main__.py:360) returns ToolDescriptor with 17 interfaces, commands=1, executable=gen-eval, contract path set, and no deprecation warning. Command: `uv run python` loading evaluation/descriptor.yaml via load_descriptor vs InterfaceDescriptor.from_yaml.

Round-7 #2 FIXED (coverage_pct operation-denominated). orchestrator.py:404-407 divides covered operations by len(per_operation). Synthetic ServiceDescriptor with one multi-surface op covered only on HTTP and one uncovered op: build_operation_coverage → coverage 50% (operation denom) vs 25% element denom (1/4 interfaces). Dogfood report: coverage_pct 58.8% = 10/17 ops for the tool archetype.

Round-7 #3 FIXED (operations_for_element HTTP). OperationSpec.interface_id('http') returns unprefixed 'POST /things'; operations_for_element('http', 'POST /things') and operations_for_element('http', 'http:POST /things') both returned ['create_thing'].

Round-7 #4 FIXED (OpenAPI $ref path items + path-level parameters). from_contract on a 3.1 doc with components/pathItems yielded 2 operations; list_items parameters included path-level 'tenant' plus query 'q'. Broken $ref raised ValueError (fail-closed). External $ref also raised.

Round-7 #5 FIXED (task 4.7 argparse gate non-tautological). Mutated build_parser() in __main__.py with --mutant-uncontracted, cleared pycache. verify_argparse reported cli:--mutant-uncontracted; pytest test_the_real_parser_declares_nothing_the_contract_omits FAILED red. Restored via git checkout; test passed green; --mutant absent from parser flags.

Round-7 #6 and #7 FIXED (argv `--` terminator and short-flag aliasing). Evaluator._cli_identifiers(['--mode','template-only','--','--descriptor'], declared) → ['cli:--mode'] only (no cli:--descriptor). With aliases, ['-v'] → ['cli:--verbose']. tests/test_argv_vocabulary.py passes.
Round-7 #8 FIXED (verify_argparse subparser descent). Undocumented --force on subparser 'run' and --secret on 'other' both produced violations: cli:run --force and cli:other --secret.

Round-7 #9 FIXED (dogfood threshold reachable). make dogfood uses --min-coverage 1 (not 80) and check_coverage_completeness.py. Ran `make dogfood`: 13/13 scenarios pass, coverage 58.8% >= 1.0%, completeness `10 of 17 units exercised (58.8%), 7 excluded with reasons`, DOGFOOD_EXIT=0. Spec tool path is completeness (not 80%); service 80% retained. Exclusions for non-declared units fail; blank reasons fail; missing report/exclusions fail.

Round-7 #10 FIXED (no unwarranted CONTRACT_VERSION bump for export reclamation). CONTRACT_VERSION remains "2"; evaluation/scenarios/contract-version.yaml pins result: 2; README asserts == "2". Schema gains are additive (per-operation fields) which policy allows without a bump. (Delta text still wrongly requires a bump — tracked as finding 2.)
findings.resolution: No change to the version constant.

findings.description: Round-7 #11 FIXED (_merge_schemas property conflicts). _merge_schemas(..., element='mcp:check_locks') with x:string vs x:integer raised ValueError naming the conflict. Compatible same-type merge succeeds with required intersection.

Round-7 #12 FIXED (--min-coverage unit ambiguity). _percentage('0.8') and parse_args(['--min-coverage','0.8',...]) raise ArgumentTypeError explaining 0.8% would pass silently; '80' → 80.0; '1' → 1.0. Dogfood scenario cli-min-coverage-rejects-a-rate exercises the rejection path.

Phase 5 gates fail-closed under deliberate breakage (not decoration). (1) generate_tool_descriptor.py --check: clean tree exit 0; executable mutated to gen-eval-MUTANT → exit 1 with drift diff; contract flag count 17→18 → exit 1 `coverage unit count mismatch`. Restored clean. (2) check_coverage_completeness: unexplained unit, blank reason, stale exclusion, zero coverage, zero declared, missing report all exit 1. (3) Empty declared tool surface: gen-eval FAIL `the descriptor declares no interfaces`. (4) CI wires --check and make dogfood (.github/workflows/ci.yml gen-eval-tests job).
